original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 Cluster for SaaS Multi-Tenant Application'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment name for resource tagging

  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID where the database cluster will be deployed

  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of subnet IDs for the DB subnet group (minimum 2 subnets in different AZs)

  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: saasapp
    Description: Name of the initial database to create

  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: dbadmin
    Description: Master username for the database cluster
    MinLength: '1'
    MaxLength: '16'
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*'

  MasterUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Master password for the database cluster
    MinLength: '8'
    MaxLength: '41'
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9!@#$%^&*()_+=]+'

  MinACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Minimum Aurora Capacity Units for Serverless v2

  MaxACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128
    Description: Maximum Aurora Capacity Units for Serverless v2

  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
    Description: Number of days to retain automated backups

  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: '03:00-04:00'
    Description: Daily time range for automated backups (UTC)

  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
    Description: Weekly time range for maintenance (UTC)

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals [!Ref EnvironmentName, 'production']

Resources:
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Family: aurora-postgresql15
      Description: Parameter group for Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
      Parameters:
        timezone: UTC
        log_statement: ddl
        log_min_duration_statement: 1000
        shared_preload_libraries: pg_stat_statements
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-params'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Family: aurora-postgresql15
      Description: Parameter group for Aurora Serverless v2 instances
      Parameters:
        max_connections: 1000
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-params'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '15.4'
      EngineMode: provisioned
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxACU
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref MasterUserPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBClusterSecurityGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !If [IsProduction, !Ref DBClusterKmsKey, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsProduction, true, false]
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      EnableHttpEndpoint: false
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: SaaS-MultiTenant

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-writer-instance'
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref DBInstanceParameterGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      PromotionTier: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-writer-instance'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: SaaS-MultiTenant

  DBClusterKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: IsProduction
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for Aurora Serverless v2 cluster encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kms-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBClusterKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: IsProduction
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cluster-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DBClusterKmsKey

Outputs:
  DBClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint for the Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-endpoint'

  DBClusterPort:
    Description: Port for the Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Port
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-port'

  DBClusterReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint for the Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-reader-endpoint'

  DBClusterResourceId:
    Description: Resource ID for the Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.DBClusterResourceId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-resource-id'

  DBClusterSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for the Aurora Serverless v2 cluster
    Value: !Ref DBClusterSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-sg-id'
